Hannah saw Kimberly buying cookies at a bakery from 7am to 8am.

The construction site was closed after 3pm.
Between what times could Kimberly have gone to the construction site?

Options:
(A) 6am to 7am
(B) 8am to 10am
(C) 10am to 11am
(D) 11am to 2pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
